div.div: Events still bubble through the React tree, not the DOM tree. A click inside a portal fires the onClick on Card — which is usually what you want, and is a genuine shock when your "click outside to close" handler lives on Card.

div.div: A portal changes where the pixels are, not who owns the component. That split is the whole feature.
